user.description: Connect to the Remote Screens add-on. With the add-on installed, Home Assistant finds it by itself; otherwise enter its address and the key from its data folder (`api_key`).

hassio_confirm.description: Set up the Remote Screens add-on, so its screens get settings entities and its services?

reauth_confirm.description: The add-on refused the key. Enter the key from its data folder (`api_key`).

not_loaded.message: Remote Screens is not set up.

unknown_screen.message: {id} is not a Remote Screens screen.

show_alert.name: Show alert
show_alert.description: Shows a message over the screens, with an optional camera and up to two buttons.

screens.name: Screens
screens.description: The screens to show it on; none is every screen.

camera.name: Camera
camera.description: A camera shown under the message, such as the doorbell.

buttons.name: Buttons
buttons.description: Up to two buttons, each with a title and an optional service and data. A button also fires remote_screens_alert_action.

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.description: Seconds before it closes by itself; 0 keeps it until tapped.

tag.name: Tag
tag.description: Sent back in remote_screens_alert_action, so an automation can tell alerts apart.

open_page.name: Open page
open_page.description: Opens a page on the screens, waking them.

screens.name: Screens
screens.description: The screens; none is every screen.

page.name: Page
page.description: The page's title, id or number (1 is the first).

screens.name: Screens
screens.description: The screens; none is every screen.

close.name: Close
close.description: Closes alerts and cards shown over the pages.

screens.name: Screens
screens.description: The screens; none is every screen.
